quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Help freely given, with a request only to pass it on, points to a warm, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: Generosity that asks only to be passed forward is a clear, moving cause of gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: The volunteers who helped us after the flood refused any payment. They just asked us to help someone else when we could.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Tension leaving your body the moment a worry is finally resolved points to a specific feeling.
quests.explanation: Feeling tension physically leave your body once a worry passes is exactly what relief feels like.
quests.textToSpeak: The pilot just announced we're landing forty minutes ahead of schedule. I actually felt my shoulders drop for the first time this whole flight.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Confidently giving wrong information, then catching yourself mid-sentence, brings an uncomfortable feeling.
quests.explanation: Realizing you confidently gave someone the wrong directions is a small, relatable cause of embarrassment.
quests.textToSpeak: I gave a lost tourist detailed directions, then realized halfway through that I'd sent him completely the wrong way.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A complaint moved around and closed without ever being addressed tends to build a strong reaction.
quests.explanation: A complaint labeled 'resolved' without anything actually being fixed is a fair cause of anger.
quests.textToSpeak: My complaint was escalated, then de-escalated, then marked resolved, without anyone actually resolving anything.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An unexpected, comfortable adjustment to a big life change points to a settled, positive feeling.
quests.explanation: Genuinely enjoying a big life change you were unsure about is a settled, quiet happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: I didn't think I'd enjoy retirement, but I've picked up three hobbies and slept well for the first time in years.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Feeling both experienced and completely new at the same time points to a familiar unease.
quests.explanation: Feeling both prepared and brand new at once, right before performing, is a classic sign of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: I can hear them counting down before the camera rolls. I've done this before. I've never done this before.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A tight connection getting tighter, with no other option left, points to a specific, uneasy feeling.
quests.explanation: A shrinking connection time with no backup option is a natural, common cause of worry.
quests.textToSpeak: The connecting flight is the last one tonight, and our first flight is already twenty minutes delayed.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Repeated effort that keeps making something worse, not better, tends to bring one familiar reaction.
quests.explanation: Rereading a document that keeps getting longer but never clearer is a plain cause of boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: I've read this report draft four times now, and each revision has made it longer without making it any clearer.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Years of saving for a trip meeting the worst possible week of weather points to a deflated feeling.
quests.explanation: Years of saving meeting the one week of bad weather is a classic, relatable disappointment.
quests.textToSpeak: I saved for this trip for two years. The one week we're here, it hasn't stopped raining.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Expecting the worst possible news and getting a small, simple answer instead points to a specific feeling.
quests.explanation: Expecting a costly problem and getting good news instead is a clear, immediate relief.
quests.textToSpeak: The mechanic said it was just a loose part, not the engine. I'd already been imagining the worst all morning.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone giving up their own time, without being asked, points to a warm, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: Someone freely giving their own time to help you is a direct, personal cause of gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: My physical therapist stayed twenty minutes past closing just to help me finish the exercises before my trip.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Careful advance planning undone by several separate failures at once tends to build a strong reaction.
quests.explanation: Multiple failures stacking on top of a carefully planned order is a fair, relatable cause of anger.
quests.textToSpeak: I ordered well in advance. The package arrived two weeks late, badly packed, and addressed to someone else entirely.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Discovering that quiet effort was noticed all along points to a warm, positive feeling.
quests.explanation: Discovering that your effort was quietly noticed and appreciated is a genuine happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: The team surprised me with a cake and a card signed by everyone. I didn't realize how much they'd noticed.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An unusual silence at a time when noise is expected points to a specific, uneasy feeling.
quests.explanation: An unusual silence when you're expecting someone home is a natural, common cause of worry.
quests.textToSpeak: This is the quietest I've ever heard this house. They should be home by now. I'll give it five more minutes.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Discovering an accidental audience partway through a public moment brings a hot, uncomfortable feeling.
quests.explanation: Realizing you had an accidental audience during a public moment is a classic cause of embarrassment.
quests.textToSpeak: I stood up to give the wedding toast and realized halfway through that my phone was still recording a video call in my pocket.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Months of anticipation ending the night before, through no fault of your own, points to a deflated feeling.
quests.explanation: Months of saving and waiting ending in a last-minute cancellation is a real, relatable disappointment.
quests.textToSpeak: I saved up for months for these concert tickets, and the headliner cancelled the night before the show.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A tiny, low-budget project outperforming giants tends to bring a strong reaction.
quests.explanation: A small, low-budget project beating far bigger competitors is a genuine cause of surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: The film made for just fifteen thousand pounds won an international award, beating movies with ten-million-dollar budgets.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Watching someone teach themselves something difficult through sheer daily effort brings a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Watching a child achieve something through their own persistence is a clear source of pride.
quests.textToSpeak: My daughter taught herself to swim this summer, just by watching videos and practicing every single day.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A small, repeating loss with no way to fix it brings a familiar, mild irritation.
quests.explanation: The same small machine failure happening three times in one month is a very relatable annoyance.
quests.textToSpeak: The vending machine at work has taken my money and given nothing back three times this month.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Representing your whole community for the first time ever points to a specific, warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Being the first team ever to represent your region is a deep source of pride.
quests.textToSpeak: We've just been told we're the first team from this region ever to qualify. We'll be representing the whole county.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Learning about a possible future solution, even if it isn't ready yet, points to a forward-looking feeling.
quests.explanation: Learning about a possible future solution, even before it's available, is a natural form of hope.
quests.textToSpeak: The specialist mentioned a new treatment starting trials next year that might actually help. It's not available yet, but it's something.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Trusted directions leading nowhere, later than expected, points to a specific, uneasy feeling.
quests.explanation: Directions that stop making sense, later than expected, in an unfamiliar place, is a natural cause of worry.
quests.textToSpeak: The GPS says we should have arrived ten minutes ago, but there's nothing around here except empty fields.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A small daily habit continuing out of routine, after someone's gone, points to a quiet feeling.
quests.explanation: A small habit continuing out of routine, after a child moves out, is a gentle, familiar sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: She left the lights on in the apartment for a week after her son moved out. Old habit, she said.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Months of work waiting on a single upcoming result points to a familiar unease.
quests.explanation: Months of work resting on one upcoming piece of feedback is a clear cause of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: The feedback from the focus group is due any minute. Six months of development come down to this data.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A long, hard project ending better than planned points to a strong, positive feeling.
quests.explanation: A difficult project ending better than expected, after a long hard year, is a well-earned happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: After the longest year of my career, the project shipped on time, under budget, and the client was delighted.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Someone offering help before you even ask points to a warm, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: Someone offering meaningful help before you even ask is a clear, personal cause of gratitude.
quests.textToSpeak: My old university professor wrote me a reference letter without me even asking, the moment she heard I was job hunting.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A familiar tool suddenly rearranged so you can't find anything points to a specific, uncertain feeling.
quests.explanation: Not being able to find a setting you use daily, after a sudden redesign, is a very ordinary confusion.
quests.textToSpeak: The new app redesign moved every single button to a different place, and I can't find the setting I use every day.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Repeated attempts to reach someone, all met with total silence, tend to build a strong reaction.
quests.explanation: Five unanswered messages over three weeks is a fair, relatable cause of anger.
quests.textToSpeak: Three weeks after the event, I still haven't received a single response to any of my five follow-up messages.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Large generosity paired with a wish to stay completely unknown draws out a particular kind of interest.
quests.explanation: Wondering what motivates someone to give generously while staying anonymous is a natural curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: The anonymous donor funded the entire new wing but refused any form of recognition. Why does someone do that?

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Noticing real personal growth compared to who you used to be points to a specific, warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Recognizing real growth in yourself, compared to months ago, is a quiet and personal form of pride.
quests.textToSpeak: Six months ago, I couldn't have handled a conversation like that. Watching myself stay calm and clear through the whole thing felt different.
